Data Analyst / Python Developer — Hartford, CT (Hybrid, 2 days remote)

We are looking for a Data Analyst with strong Python skills to join our
analytics team supporting retail and e-commerce clients.

Requirements:
- 1+ years of experience with Python, Pandas, and SQL
- Experience building dashboards or visualizations (Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
- Comfortable writing SQL queries including joins and aggregations

Preferred:
- Experience with Scikit-learn or other ML libraries
- Familiarity with AWS

This is an entry-to-junior level position on our data team.

We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this role; candidates must
be authorized to work in the U.S. without company sponsorship, now or in
the future.
